forensic_findings.message: SHARE COUNT EXPANSION (FY2025): Shares outstanding at year end rose 16.64% to 3,751.0M; investigate equity awards, conversions or issuances, and use the period-end count for per-share value.

TAX ANOMALY (FY2023): Reported earnings include a $5,001.0M tax benefit on positive pre-tax income of $9,973.0M; a deferred tax adjustment of $-6,349.0M (-42.3% of net income). Net income and margins for this year are not comparable without normalization (e.g. valuation-allowance release).
NON-CORE INCOME DEPENDENCE (FY2025): Non-operating income of $923.0M equals 21.2% of operating income; pre-tax earnings lean on interest and other income rather than the core business.
STOCK-BASED COMPENSATION INTENSITY (FY2025): SBC of $2,825.0M equals 19.2% of operating cash flow and 64.9% of operating income; SBC-adjusted FCF is $3,395.0M.

CAPEX-DRIVEN FCF (FY2025): Free cash flow rose $2,639.0M while operating cash flow changed $-176.0M; a $2,815.0M capex reduction explains 106.7% of the improvement, so it reflects lower reinvestment rather than stronger cash generation.
NEGATIVE OPERATING LEVERAGE (FY2025): Operating expenses grew +22.80% against revenue growth of -2.93% (25.7pp gap).
MARGIN COMPRESSION: Operating margin moved from 9.19% (FY2023) to 4.59% (FY2025), -460 bps; worst single year FY2025 (-265 bps).
NON-CORE INCOME DEPENDENCE (FY2024): Non-operating income of $1,914.0M equals 27.1% of operating income; pre-tax earnings lean on interest and other income rather than the core business.
NEGATIVE OPERATING LEVERAGE (FY2024): Operating expenses grew +18.30% against revenue growth of +0.95% (17.4pp gap).
